audit_kind: read-only source/test audit; no implementation changes or test reruns during this inventory pass

coverage_semantics.routed: Classifier recognizes a method/path shape. This alone is not a semantic implementation, especially reserved names shadowed by {id}.
coverage_semantics.typed_request_or_response: Named borrowed core wire model exists; availability does not imply every upstream field/behavior is modeled, nor that std server uses it.
coverage_semantics.core_service_implemented: Reusable no_std VaultService operation exists. Adapter-only auth/config/profile/sync/read builders are separate.
coverage_semantics.http_tested: At least one checked-in exact-method positive or negative request exists; positive/negative and restart evidence are kept separate.
coverage_semantics.cli_command_coverage: Named pinned CLI2026.10.0 command behavior demonstrated by checked-in e2e suite, historically recorded passing against no-warden and Vaultwarden1.37.4.
coverage_semantics.cli_endpoint_attribution: Static official client callsites are recorded separately. Current harness captures no server request trace, so no per-route trace claim is made.
coverage_semantics.full_upstream_parity_verified: Never inferred from a routed enum, a Value placeholder, a 404 rejection, or one passing command; all records remain false until exhaustive behavior comparison exists.

not_proved: Firmware is linked, not executed on RISC-V hardware.

HTTP, SQLite, JSON Value, clocks, RNG and cryptography live in std no-warden-server and may allocate.
Escaped borrowed strings require a caller-owned decoder scratch buffer; std adapter uses owned Value before borrowing.
Host workspace test feature unification does not substitute for isolated no_std/no_alloc target checks.
allocation_free_boundary.ci_symbol_scan: No nm symbol scan is committed; CI links without a global allocator. Earlier local firmware inspection recorded _start and zero undefined/allocator symbols, but this inventory pass did not rerun that inspection.

recommended_first_parity_chunk.name: Personal-vault bulk import through the real bw import command
recommended_first_parity_chunk.current_failure: Classifier treats literal import as an item ID and dispatches CipherUpdate("import"). Standard import bodies are then decoded incorrectly as CipherRequest (normally rejected for missing type/name), rather than handled as an import. No typed ImportCiphersRequest, import service, folder-index mapping or atomic bulk transaction exists.
recommended_first_parity_chunk.why_first: Large missing CLI workflow for moving a real personal vault into the reusable implementation, independent of organization membership/billing/account provisioning.
minimum_next_chunk_evidence: Pin the exact upstream import request/response and folder relationship semantics before modeling it.
Provide caller-owned/bounded import models and atomic storage/business operation without adding alloc to core.
HTTP tests reject cross-owner references and prove partial failures do not commit a partially imported vault.
Run actual bw import with a supported format containing folders and several items; sync/fresh-client read verifies decrypted imported content.
Run the same import scenario against the pinned Vaultwarden baseline and retain behavior differences explicitly.
